source: Annex1: original video and supplied text; emotion labels not used for fitting or tuning

text.unit: normalized spoken word mapped to original character span and BERT subwords

time.reference: container origin, decoded audio sample clock and video PTS

mask_meanings.alignment_supported: word/audio relationship passes the fixed use rule; false does not erase text or native AV
mask_meanings.word_expression_mask: word association and valid face observation
mask_meanings.word_scene_mask: word association and valid scene observation
mask_meanings.word_audio_dim_mask: per-feature availability including voiced-only pitch columns

annex2_3_interface: Separate supplied benchmark interface; same field name or embedding dimension does not establish row-wise equivalence
public_resources: Independent waveform origin and quantitative same-source text, timestamp, F0/voicing and face-detection comparisons; references never replace the raw inputs or the primary features.
labels: Annex1 includes labels; they are not needed for this fixed feature-extraction pipeline
optional_pitch_diagnostic: external_validation/pitch_crosscheck: 100 samples; time, both F0 estimates, joint_voiced, absolute_semitone_gap, within_one_semitone; invalid gaps zero-filled under joint_voiced mask; no automatic deletion or prediction benefit claimed.
